g.text: 1. GRAPHICAL SYMBOLS PER IEC 60617. DESIGNATIONS AFTER IEC 81346.
2. ALL BREAKERS SHOWN CLOSED; DISCONNECTS SHOWN CLOSED.
3. DATA BLOCKS ARE THE CORRIDOR RECORD.
4. RATINGS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE AND NOT FOR SETTINGS OR SWITCHING.
